base_prompt: We have ten days to deliver a 12-minute AI-film festival pilot. It has two hero dialogue scenes, one difficult vehicle crash, and many low-risk establishing and insert shots. Compare a quality-max workflow, a speed-max-with-quality-floor workflow, and a recommended hybrid. Give hard floors, which shots run in parallel or serially, retry/route ceilings, post-production responsibilities, and measurable KPIs. We have not run a controlled benchmark, so distinguish policy from proven performance and do not invent costs or success rates.
